text:
alex: Preliminary proposal: introduce a "degrade-then-fallback" policy for canaries. Start canary at 5% traffic, if latency drifts above threshold start a 60s degrade window (reduce model qps / inject slower path) and only if errors/latency remain high after grace period, failover to fallback variant/region.

maria: sounds sensible. how do we measure "latency drifts above threshold"? p50 vs baseline or p95?

srini: config sketch:
```
policy:
  type: degrade_then_fallback
  canary_percent: 5
  latency_threshold_ms: 120
  grace_period_sec: 60
  max_degrade_steps: 3
  fallback_order: [quantized, regional, lower_tier]
```

devon: how does this interact with quotas and cost? degrading may increase tokens/time and cost.

pm_jess: console UX: we should expose a preview of the canary weight timeline and a "simulate degrade" button, also show expected cost delta per step.

ops_ira: oncall concern: need explicit runbook hooks + smoke hooks to abort. If degrade doesn't reduce errors, we should auto-rollback the canary after X failures.

oncall-bot: ALERT: simulated canary run shows error_rate spike -> 8% at t=+40s; automated mitigation triggered: initiated degrade step 1.

alex: good catch @ops_ira, add `abort_after_consecutive_failures: 3` and an option to notify oncall Slack channel.

srini: telemetry queries we plan to attach to the policy (example Prometheus):
```
rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",model="m1-canary"}[1m])
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
```

maria: also need token-cost and latency histograms per model-variant + per-region. will add dashboard panels.

devon: test matrix: canary sizes [1,5,10], failure modes (latency spike, oom, kv-cache-miss). call out capacity fallback to warm a smaller model variant rather than region failover by default.

pm_jess: agree. I'll prototype the console flow: toggle for `degrade_then_fallback`, settings form, and a "dry-run" that renders expected telemetry.

alex: ok next steps: srini to land policy proto + control-plane checks, jess to wire console mock, maria to add dash panels, devon + ops to write runbook. follow up in next sync. :thumbsup:
